Some sages have made a mention of Kala Dasha and Chakra Dasha; but they have recognised the Kalachakra Dasha as supreme. The other kinds of Dasha propagated by the learned, are Chara Dasha (चर दशा), Sthira Dasha (स्थिर दशा), Kendra Dasha (केन्द्र दशा), Karaka Dasha (कारक दशा), Brahmagraha Dasha (ब्रहम्ग्रह दशा), Mandook Dasha (मण्डूक दशा), Shool Dasha (शूल दशा), Yogardha Dasha (योगार्ध दशा), Drig Dasha (दृग दशा), Trikona Dasha (व्िकोण दशा), Rashi Dasha (राशश दशा), Panchswara Dasha (पंचस्वरा दशा), Yogini Dasha (योगगनी दशा), Pinda Dasha (व्पण्ड दशा), Naisargika Dasha (नैसगगधक दशा), AshtaVarga Dasha (अष्टवगध दशा), Sandhya Dasha(संध्या दशा), Pachaka Dasha, (पाचक दशा), Tara Dash

Now I shall describe to you the Chara Dasha of the signs (Rāśhis) of the twelve houses. In this Dasha system the number of years of Dasha is reckoned from the Rashi up to the house in which its lord is posited. The peculiar feature of this system is that every three signs from Aries etc. have four Padas. For the odd (1,3) Padas, the counting is done from Rashi onwards up to the Rashi in which its lord is housed. For the even Padas (2, 4) this counting is done in the reverse order. र्ृसिकाथधपिी द्वौ च केिुभौमौ स्मृिौ द्वद्वज । शतनि

Aquarius is in even Pada, therefore, counting has to be done from Aquarius up to Rahu in the reverse order by which the Chara Dasha for Aquarius would come to 8 years. Aries is in odd Pada. Therefore, the Chara Dasha for Aries will be one year. The Dasha of other signs should be calculated in the same manner. In this system, the first Dasha Commences from the strongest amongst the signs in trine (व्िकोण) to the Ascendant (1, 5, 9). The Dasha system is similar to the Chara Dasha. Here also the Dasha of the signs will be in the onwards order in the case of odd signs and in the reverse order in the case of even. The Dasha years will be similar to that of Chara Dasha have been named Trikona because of the commencement of the Dasha from the signs in Trine. Example-Refer to the birth chart given earlier. Jaimini_Sutras.context: me time cantaining a world of meaning If Mesha or Dhanus becomes Karakamsa with a benefic there, there will be the highest Bliss. If Mesha or Dhanus becomes the 12th from Karakamsa and Kethu is there, there will be the highest Bliss or Moksha. Kethu is not a full benefic. Kethu becomes a benefic in Chara Dasa and not otherwise. Therefore he cannot be classified as ४ subhagrahz. But astrology ascribes to him the highest spiritual power of emancipation from all births and re-births and give man Moksha. . ७१, पापेरन्यथा ॥ Su. 71. Papairanyatha. If the 12th from the Karakamsa is occupied by evil planets he will go to hell and will have no Bliss. NOTES . Heaven and Hell are not seen. But there is the uni- versal belief in their existence and all religions lend support to this faith. ७२. रविकेतुम्यां
